verification.details: No benchmark-side prompt, task-selection, tool-schema, tool-result or evaluator changes are declared. modified_prompts refers to benchmark-supplied prompts, not the disclosed product-internal domain scaffolds. All base IDs are present and scored; no omitted questions. The sole stock source diff is the transport hook. Dependency/model-registry differences, external-account voices and known retries are disclosed in notes. Owner Yechang Hu confirmed on 2026-09-26 that the submitted system was not trained specifically on tau-bench tasks, rewards or evaluation data and did not access hidden task goals, reference answers/actions, evaluator state or other benchmark data outside the standard agent interface. This is an owner declaration, not independent provenance verification or official acceptance.

methodology.notes: AI Rudder Voice: single-brain Gemini gemini-3.7-flash (OpenAI-compatible API), Deepgram nova-3 ASR at 8 kHz, ElevenLabs eleven_flash_v2_5 agent TTS. The product includes VIE, internal domain scaffolds and a Realtime-compatible endpoint routing by benchmark-visible policy/tools. Tools execute in stock tau2. No fast/slow dual-brain system. Campaign va20260926a, 2026-09-26, Virginia; full base: retail 114, airline 50, telecom 114; regular, one trial; concurrency 6/3/12. No Banking. Stock b7ea9074c1cba482b30687fecdb5c8425fd6f619 plus a disclosed +18/-0 transport hook; system 373bde7430eddea1dcc045454e5ab5fa069b8b34; VIE 8594843b44d385faf967f25981864d78ade60bce. Python 3.12.13, litellm 1.82.6 (upstream lock is 1.81.11), google-genai 1.63.0, pydantic 2.12.4. Voice simulator v1.0; user TTS eleven_v3; reused external-account voice batch v4 (seed 20260925, design model eleven_ttv_v3, seven-persona mapping SHA256 prefix 6c65ae3e684773a9); regular uses five personas. These are not Sierra voices. Voice seed 300, tick 0.2s, maximum 1200 virtual seconds; NL assertions gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, hallucination review claude-opus-4-5, retries=3, no auto-review. First completed valid attempt under the stock retry/discard protocol; no best-of selection. Client-to-endpoint was same-host loopback, not an external Sierra rerun. Official interaction_metrics use retained tick trajectories, not journal TTFS. Default user generation gpt-4.1-2025-04-14, temperature 0. Hallucination-discarded questions/attempts: retail 3/3, airline 2/2, telecom 5/6. No whole-task runner Retry banners. Two 50s brain-call timeouts occurred: airline task 20 failed; the affected telecom task recovered and passed. This association does not establish the airline failure cause.
